title: Marketing Business Support - maternity cover
description: Overview Marketing Business Support - maternity cover at Kyowa Kirin International plc Milan, Italy WE PUSH THE BOUNDARIES OF MEDICINE. LEAPING FORWARD TO MAKE PEOPLE SMILE At Kyowa Kirin International (KKI), our purpose is to make people smile. This means more than drug discovery and development; it is about embedding care into everything we do to make a difference every day for those that need it most. We’re an inclusive pharmaceutical company that takes time to understand what really matters to our patients, their families, and their healthcare professionals, helping our people to take bold actions that deliver life-changing solutions sooner. Our culture is rooted in our values: Teamwork, Commitment to Life, Innovation, and Integrity. They help us to push boundaries to deliver extraordinary impact and make KKI a brilliant place to work. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities: Provide administrative support with marketing activities including budget control, project management, etc. Manage creative agencies, promotional materials and monitor campaigns Support business insight/analytics and forecasting Support with brand and tactical planning e.g., preparing inputs, workshops, consolidating versions, managing reviews, maintaining and tracking tactical plans, supporting budgeting, ad hoc research Support basic CRM maintenance and administration (as a back up to the CRM Manager) Placing purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with purchasing and billing standards Qualifications Position Requirements Experience in a commercial administration role either a sales support or marketing assistant position of at least 2 years Proactive, with strong attention to detail and able to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment Experience in the pharmaceutical industry strongly preferred Knowledge of Microsoft Office Veeva environment knowledge preferred Good English language skills preferred What we offer: Salary range between: €29,115.00  Annually up to  €43,672.00 Annually Kyowa Kirin International is an equal opportunity employer. No agencies please.
